title: Nine Minutes to Come
subtitle: 应急救援 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 应急救援（灾害防范·救援与急救）
meta: 主题语境：应急救援（灾害防范·救援与急救）　|　核心词汇：ambulance　|　正文 368 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ambulance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the ① ambulance took nine minutes to come and forty-one to arrive, and my grandmother said the difference between the two is the whole history of that street. She had to ② call an ambulance twice in her life and both times it was for the same man, and she said calling is the only thing in the world you do with your whole hand; an ambulance, she said, is a vehicle that arrives after the decision.

The ③ ambulance service in the town was two men and a telephone, and one of them was my uncle, who had never been trained and was very good. He went ④ in an ambulance for the first time in 1958 at the age of nineteen, as a patient, and he said that was the whole of his training; an ambulance, he said, is the only vehicle judged by the minutes it did not take.

Every ⑤ ambulance door in the county opened the same way, and he said a door you can open with one hand is a door designed by somebody who has been told the truth. The ⑥ ambulance man who came in 1971 was nineteen and had been doing it for nine months, and my grandmother said the word man in that phrase is the kindest lie in the language; an ambulance, she said, always brings two people and takes one.

The ⑦ ambulance itself, meaning the service and not the van, was run from a house with a bell until 1974, and the bell is in a drawer. My uncle was ⑧ the ambulance for eleven years, by which the town meant him and not the vehicle, and he said being the ambulance is the only job where your name is a thing with wheels; an ambulance, he said, is what a town calls one man for thirty years.

The  ambulance I remember is the one in 1964 that took nine minutes to come and forty-one to arrive, with my father in the back. An  ambulance, my mother said in 1996, is the only thing a street hears once and remembers for forty years; ours has never stopped hearing it, and the ambulance was late and everybody in the street knew why.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 救护服务；急救运送
C. （作定语）救护车的；救护的
D. n. 救护人员；救护队
E. 固定搭配：call an ambulance 叫救护车
F. 固定搭配：in an ambulance 在救护车上；用救护车运送
G. 固定搭配：ambulance service 救护服务；急救机构
H. 固定搭配：an ambulance man / worker 救护人员

items.q: The ambulance took nine minutes to come
call an ambulance twice in her life
The ambulance service in the town
went in an ambulance for the first time
Every ambulance door in the county
The ambulance man who came in 1971
The ambulance itself, meaning the service
was the ambulance for eleven years

answers.why: ambulance 意为“救护车”，1964 年那辆救护车九分钟出发、四十一分钟才到。
call an ambulance 意为“叫救护车”，她一生叫过两次救护车，两次都是为了同一个人。
ambulance service 意为“救护服务、急救机构”，镇上的救护服务是两个人加一部电话。
in an ambulance 意为“在救护车上”，1958 年他十九岁时第一次坐救护车，身份是病人。
ambulance 作定语，意为“救护车的”，全县每一扇救护车门都是同一种开法。
an ambulance man 意为“救护人员”，1971 年来的是个十九岁的救护员，只干了九个月。
ambulance 意为“救护服务、急救运送”，1974 年前救护服务是在一栋带铃的房子里运转的。
ambulance 意为“救护人员、救护队”，我叔叔当了十一年“救护车”，镇上指的是他本人而不是那辆车。

1958 年他十九岁时第一次坐救护车，身份是病人，他说那就是他受过的全部训练。（in an ambulance）
1971 年来的是个十九岁的救护员，只干了九个月。（an ambulance man）

She had to call an ambulance twice in her life, and both times it was for the same man.

He went in an ambulance for the first time in 1958 at the age of nineteen, as a patient.

Until 1974 the ambulance was run from a house with a bell.
